name: Debut
description:
Hello, soldier. I see you've been recently split from your people. What a shame.. but not all is lost. You obviously aren't going to be surviving here alone, let's make that clear. If you want to stay on your little vacation for a while, you're going to need to get your hands dirty. Now, now.. I know you're probably itching to do some spec-ops job already! I'm not entrusting you with that level of work yet. You think I just give big jobs to any random bum who walks in here?
Let's start simple. The Customs area has been overrun with people of your kind, no offense. This is causing a lot of problems for me and my men, as shipping things through that zone has become a pain in the ass. I can't count how many times my men have been robbed by USEC or shot by BEAR. I need you to go out there, and clear out some of the people that have been causing a mess in Customs. Yes, yes.. I'll obviously pay you. I'm not that much of a cheapskate! Now, get to work. Report back when you're done.
